Problem first. Then the evidence. Then the principle.

Each mission starts with a real problem from the Érable Cycles audit. You make a first guess, you take the evidence apart with your own hands (real values from the course VMs), and only then do you read the principle that explains what you saw. Points reward reasoning, not speed: first-try answers earn the most.
